The test `test_timedelta_tolerance_nearest` checks whether the `pd.merge_asof` function handles timedelta tolerance correctly when merging DataFrames. The failure indicates that there is an issue with the data types of the keys being used for merging, specifically that they are not integers, timestamps, or floats.

To resolve this issue, ensure that the `time` column in both DataFrames is properly converted to `Timedelta`. This can be confirmed by checking the data types of the columns before and after conversion.
